shellCommands.command: cat /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md; echo ----; ls -R /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui; echo ----; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/AGENTS.md; echo ----; ls /home/sandbox/workspace; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50; echo ----; for f in src/*; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done; echo ----; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; echo ----; sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; echo ----; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Button Text Flex Box Avatar Card Divider 2>&1 | head -120
cd /home/sandbox/workspace; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Button Text Flex Box Avatar Card Divider 2>&1 | head -150

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; for c in TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar Card Divider Text; do echo "=== $c"; ls $U/$c/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; done; echo; echo "=== TextInput props"; cat $U/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts $U/controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$' | head -120

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; ls $U/controls/TextInput/*.d.ts; echo "=== TextInput"; grep -v '^$' $U/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -60; echo "=== Select types"; grep -v '^$' $U/Select/types.d.ts | grep -n -E 'value|onUpdate|options|label|width|size|placeholder|filterable|SelectOption\b|SelectProps' | head -40; echo "=== Switch"; grep -v '^$' $U/Switch/Switch.d.ts; echo "=== Checkbox"; grep -v '^$' $U/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; echo "=== ControlProps"; grep -v '^$' $U/types.d.ts | sed -n 1,80p

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; echo "=== Avatar"; grep -v '^$' $U/Avatar/Avatar.d.ts $U/Avatar/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo "=== Card"; grep -v '^$' $U/Card/Card.d.ts | head -40; echo "=== Text"; grep -v '^$' $U/Text/Text.d.ts | head -40; grep -rn "TEXT_VARIANTS\|export type TextVariant\|variant" $U/Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== Flex/Box"; grep -v '^$' $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -70; grep -v '^$' $U/layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head -40; echo "=== Divider"; grep -v '^$' $U/Divider/Divider.d.ts; echo "=== spacing export"; grep -n "spacing\|sp\b" $U/layout/index.d.ts $U/layout/spacing/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; echo "=== Avatar types"; grep -v '^$' $U/Avatar/types/main.d.ts $U/Avatar/types/common.d.ts $U/Avatar/types/image.d.ts $U/Avatar/types/text.d.ts $U/Avatar/types/icon.d.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^\s*\*\|/\*\*' | head -70; echo "=== colorText"; grep -n "COLOR\|color?" $U/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -5; echo "=== Toaster"; grep -rn "export" $U/Toaster/index.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== icons"; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -i -E 'upload|camera|trash|arrow-up-from|^picture|^pencil' ; echo "=== README setup"; grep -n -i -A12 "Required setup\|## Install" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -60; echo "=== layout refs"; rg -n -E "Space|breakpoint|\| `?(s|m|l|xl|xxl|xxxl)`? *\||Row|Col |Container" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; echo "=== layout.md"; rg -n "Space|breakpoint|xxxl|<Row|<Col|Container|--g-spacing" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | head -45; echo "=== AvatarImage/Text"; grep -v '^$' $U/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts $U/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^\S*:\s*\*\|/\*\*' | head -30; echo "=== icons upload"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -i -E '^(Arrow(Up|Down)From|CloudArrow|FileArrow|ArrowUp)' | grep '\.d\.ts'; echo "=== Button"; grep -v '^$' $U/Button/Button.d.ts | grep -E "view\?|size\?|loading|width|onClick|disabled|type\?|pin|selected|ButtonView|ButtonSize" | head -20; echo "=== Select.d.ts"; grep -v '^$' $U/Select/Select.d.ts | head -30; echo "=== Toaster types"; grep -v '^$' $U/Toaster/types.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*\*\|/\*\*' | head -60; echo "=== ToasterProvider"; grep -v '^$' $U/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts; echo "=== Icon"; grep -v '^$' $U/Icon/Icon.d.ts | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; echo "=== BUTTON_VIEWS"; grep -n "BUTTON_VIEWS" -A3 $U/Button/constants.d.ts | head -8; echo "=== Toaster class"; grep -v '^$' $U/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== ToasterComponent"; grep -v '^$' $U/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts | head -15; echo "=== ONLINE"; curl -sS -m 20 -o /tmp/uikit7.md -w "http=%{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; head -c 300 /tmp/uikit7.md; echo; grep -n -i "required setup\|ToasterProvider\|## Select\|## Avatar\|## Switch" /tmp/uikit7.md | head -20
cd /home/sandbox/workspace; sed -i "/^import \* as React from 'react';$/d" src/App.tsx; sed -i '1{/^$/d}' src/App.tsx; head -3 src/App.tsx; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
